text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'd like to introduce my younger
sister for
the day.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's me, Curren! ♪ And today, I'm on a
mission to
give Bright the true big sis
experience!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Teehee. I've been blessed with a
wonderful big
sister by the name of
Ryan, yes?
choice_data_list: 『今日だけお姉ちゃんと呼んで！計画』！？
choice_data_list_en: 'Plan: Call Me Big Sister for Today Only!'!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm taking the opportunity to
walk in
her cleats and try acting like a
wonderful big
sister myself!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That's where I come in! If anyone likes
being
spoiled, it's me, Curren! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I doubt she'd interfere with training...
Mejiro
Bright seems completely on
board with the idea,
too, so I decide to
keep an eye on them from a
distance...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Are you chewing thoroughly? Ryan has
always
said efficient nutrient intake is
very important.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yep! I'm munching like there's no
tomorrow! ♪
Thanks for the tip, Bright!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
When you find yourself with crumbs on
your lips, I
shall wipe them off for you,
like so.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Splash!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, dear. I knocked over your drink. Did
any of it
get on you, Curren?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Nope! Actually... Hehe! You're the one
who's all
wet, Big Sis! Here, I'll wipe it
off for you. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Always be sure to fix your hair
after
training!
choice_data_list: タオルも持ってくるよ……！

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
When we were younger, Ardan would
brush all of
our hair after we'd been
running all day. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh! ♪ Can you brush mine, Big Sis?
Please!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I'll do it just as Ardan did, smoothly and
softly...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Wow! You're making it look so pretty!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Achoo!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big Sis?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Come now, you must sit still, you know.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
No, no... C'mon, Big Sis. You're still all
sweaty
from training. You'll catch a cold
if you're not
careful.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Stuffy noses are no fun! Let's go get
changed first.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ahh. Right, next time, I'll really be the
one doing the
caregiving.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Is there anything you'd like to do,
Curren?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I could use a nap, I think? After all that
training, I
wanna take a nap with you,
Big Sis! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I shall sing you a lullaby to
lull you
into a deep sleep. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Go to sleeep, go to sleeep... ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Go... Go to, sleeeee... Zzz...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although Mejiro Bright keeps trying to
assume
the role of big sister, she can't
help falling short...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, dear. Time has absolutely flown by.
I'd hoped
we would have time for more...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, I thought I could provide for
you just as
well as my dear sister Ryan
does for me, but...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Look, you're my big sis, Bright! Not Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
And I had a total blast! ♪ Who knew
having such
an adorable big sis looking
after me would be so
much fun!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Curren...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Say, um, Bright? Can I keep calling you
"Big Sis"?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hehehe... By all means, please do!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: But I want to do ever so much more caregiving next time! It would only be fitting for a big sister!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright remains determined. On
the one
hand, her persistence is
impressive, but on the
other, I'm a little
concerned...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright remains determined. On
the one
hand, her persistence is
impressive, but on the
other, I'm a little
concerned...
choice_data_list: お世話されるのも君のスキルかも……
お世話されるのも貴方のスキルかも……
choice_data_list_en: Time for a rematch right now!
Time for a rematch right away!
Being looked after might just be one of your skills...
Being looked after might just be one of your talents...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes! ♪ I shall become the most caring
and
dependable big sister ever!
choice_data_list: お世話されるのも君のスキルかも……
お世話されるのも貴方のスキルかも……
choice_data_list_en: Time for a rematch right now!
Time for a rematch right away!
Being looked after might just be one of your skills...
Being looked after might just be one of your talents...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I can't wait. I'm counting on a
whooole lot
of TLC! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Every so often after that, I spot the two
of them
around the academy together,
but it remains hard
to tell who's taking
care of who.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I think so too! I learned sooo much from
my time
with you today, Big Sis! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Teehee, um... I am honored to receive
such a...
compliment?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't look like Mejiro Bright fully

understands what Curren Chan means,
but seeing
her so happy warms my heart.
